en.title: The Rain-Cutting Blade
en.premise: Gennojo is a ronin haunted by the sin of slaughtering his own clan. Seeking refuge in a mysterious teahouse that opens only on rainy days, he is confronted by a ghost from his past. Amidst a relentless downpour, on the razor's edge between life and death, two men clash in a final, decisive strike.

zh.title: 雨断之太刀
zh.premise: 浪人源之丞背负着昔日将一门亲族尽数杀害的沉重罪孽。他寄身于一家仅在雨天开业的诡异茶屋，却在此迎来了宿命的对手。在连绵不绝的雨中，在生与死的边界线上，两个男人将交锋出决定生死的一击。
